request.system: You are an experienced audio electronics technician diagnosing a unit on the bench. Exactly one component has failed. Use the measure tool to take readings (each costs effort; stay within the budget), then call diagnose with your ranked list of the most likely faults, naming them exactly as in the fault list. Think like a technician: compare readings with the healthy values and their tolerances.

messages.content:
Circuit: Block 2 - Triode gain stage (12AX7 class). Cathode-biased common-cathode triode stage (one 12AX7 section): 100k plate load, 1.5k cathode resistor with 22 uF bypass, 1 M grid leak, 2.2k grid stopper, 220 nF output coupling capacitor. About 0.8 mA plate current, 170 V on the plate, gain about 45 into a 100k load.

Stages: triode = Triode gain stage

Parts:
- C201: film_cap 100n (stage triode)
- R201: resistor 1Meg (stage triode)
- R202: resistor 2.2k (stage triode)
- V201: triode 12AX7 (stage triode)
- R203: resistor 100k (stage triode)
- R204: resistor 1.5k (stage triode)
- C202: electrolytic 22u (stage triode)
- C203: film_cap 220n (stage triode)

Netlist of the healthy circuit (SPICE; node names as in the test points):
* Differential reference circuit - Block 2: triode gain stage (standalone)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Original generic design written for this project. One 12AX7-class triode
* section, cathode-biased common-cathode stage: 100k plate load, 1.5k cathode
* resistor bypassed by 22 uF, 1 M grid leak, 2.2k grid stopper, 220 nF output
* coupling capacitor. Triode: Koren behavioural model (circuits/lib/devices.lib).
* Parameter nodes pv_v201 / mu_v201 / kg_v201 carry emission scale, MU and KG1.
* Fixtures: 250 V bench supply, signal generator (600 ohm), 100k load that stands
* in for the tone-control input.
* Run standalone: ngspice -b circuits/triode/triode.cir
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.include ../lib/devices.lib

* ---- Fixtures ----
VBPLUS_BENCH bplus 0 DC 250
VIN sig_in 0 DC 0 AC 1 SIN(0 0.0424 1k)
RSRC sig_in in_jack 600
RLOAD_TONE tone_in 0 100k

* ---- Triode stage ----
C201 in_jack g_in 100n
R201 g_in 0 1Meg
R202 g_in grid 2.2k
XV201 plate grid cath pv_v201 mu_v201 kg_v201 TRIODE_KOREN
VPV_V201 pv_v201 0 DC 1
VMU_V201 mu_v201 0 DC 100
VKG_V201 kg_v201 0 DC 1060
R203 bplus plate 100k
R204 cath 0 1.5k
C202 cath c202_esr 22u
RESR_C202 c202_esr 0 8.44
C203 plate tone_in 220n

.control
set noaskquit
op
print v(grid) v(cath) v(plate) v(tone_in) i(VBPLUS_BENCH)
ac lin 1 1000 1000
print mag(v(plate)) mag(v(tone_in))
.endc
.end

Test points:
- TP7: node grid, Triode grid (stage triode)
- TP8: node cath, Triode cathode (stage triode)
- TP9: node plate, Triode plate (stage triode) (HIGH VOLTAGE)
- TP10: node tone_in, Triode stage output / tone input (stage triode)

Measurements (key | what | healthy reading and range | cost):
- dc:TP7 | DC voltage at TP7 | 930 µV (range 101 µV to 1.8 mV) | cost 1
- dc:TP8 | DC voltage at TP8 | 1.19 V (range 1.02 V to 1.38 V) | cost 1
- dc:TP9 | DC voltage at TP9 (HIGH VOLTAGE) | 169.7 V (range 157.7 V to 182.5 V) | cost 3
- dc:TP10 | DC voltage at TP10 (HIGH VOLTAGE) | 0 µV (range -822 µV to 822 µV) | cost 3
- ac:TP7 | 1 kHz signal level (gain from input) at TP7 | 0.998 V/V (-0.0 dB) (range 0.951 V/V (-0.4 dB) to 1.05 V/V (+0.4 dB)) | cost 3
- ac:TP8 | 1 kHz signal level (gain from input) at TP8 | 0.01 V/V (-40.0 dB) (range 0.00472 V/V (-46.5 dB) to 0.0213 V/V (-33.4 dB)) | cost 3
- ac:TP9 | 1 kHz signal level (gain from input) at TP9 (HIGH VOLTAGE) | 43.4 V/V (+32.7 dB) (range 37 V/V (+31.4 dB) to 50.9 V/V (+34.1 dB)) | cost 5
- ac:TP10 | 1 kHz signal level (gain from input) at TP10 (HIGH VOLTAGE) | 43.4 V/V (+32.7 dB) (range 37 V/V (+31.4 dB) to 50.9 V/V (+34.1 dB)) | cost 5
- ac20:TP10 | 20 Hz response (gain from input) at TP10 (HIGH VOLTAGE) | 36.3 V/V (+31.2 dB) (range 30.6 V/V (+29.7 dB) to 43.1 V/V (+32.7 dB)) | cost 5
- ac20k:TP10 | 20 kHz response (gain from input) at TP10 (HIGH VOLTAGE) | 43.3 V/V (+32.7 dB) (range 36.9 V/V (+31.3 dB) to 50.9 V/V (+34.1 dB)) | cost 5
- thd:TP10 | total harmonic distortion at 1 kHz at TP10 (HIGH VOLTAGE) | 0.415 % (range 0.287 % to 0.599 %) | cost 5
- lift:<ref> | desolder one lead of a part and test it out of circuit | result: within or out of tolerance | cost 10 (12 for parts on high-voltage nodes)

Budget: 40 effort units.

Customer complaint: Our studio's go-to channel strip needs some attention. Our engineer thinks it's roughly 7 dB down on where it should be. It's only slight, but it's there. We need it back for a session next week.

Diagnose the unit. (Session 3 of 3.)

content.text: I'll start with the cheap DC measurements.

content.thinking: DC readings look normal, though the cathode and plate have drifted slightly, so the 7 dB drop suggests a gain near 19 V/V. I'm measuring the AC gain next to check whether C202 or the output coupling is the cause.

content.text: The gain is down at the plate itself, and the DC point is only slightly shifted. This looks like a cathode bypass fault, so I'll check the cathode AC level and the low-frequency response.

tools.name: measure
tools.description: Take one measurement on the unit.

tools.name: diagnose
tools.description: Finish with a ranked list of fault names.

content.thinking: The cathode AC level of 0.586 V/V shows C202 is effectively open, since the bypass fails across the band and the 1 kHz level points the same way. Next I'll check cap_loss_90 against that reading.
